sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Retain the conditional applicability design and case binding, but repair the oblique endpoint rule to preserve the prior instruction: accept endpoint coordinates equal to Omega by requiring lowerCoordinate <= Omega <= upperCoordinate, while separately issuing a violation unless lowerCoordinate < upperCoordinate (thereby preventing zero/reversed interpolation denominators). Also, for an applicable case explicitly report a violation when netWebThickness is zero, because z_na is undefined and the current ?tw != 0 filter silently skips its required formula validation.
